summary: Tested the 4 requested features. Backend: PUT /api/me/features and GET /api/auth/me show_sundowners (4/4 pytest pass). UI at 390x844 (plus a desktop check of the photo dialog): Feature Settings checkbox (off by default, saves, persists after reload); SundownerCard only renders when user.show_sundowners is true (checked in the code, BoatPrep.jsx:1053; card not reproducible because it also needs sunset and a cocktail list); box badge ('2 boxes', the old folders text is gone from the count); full-screen PhotoSwipe (1 and 2 photos, prev/next/counter, scroll swipe, sub-box sections, tick marks the row removed in red and shows in the inventory count after reload, edit opens Edit Item and qty updates live); Route Planning (no '(optional)' on Finish, red navigator-finish-required clears once the time is set, arrive-type bubbles select/unselect and persist, Start folded with the 'Same as DEPARTURE DATE AND TIME' text and stays expanded after reload, Add Leg dialog with all 4 validation errors in order, START and Departure default to the previous leg's destination and finish, planned-leg rows, edit, delete with Undo, trip-confirm only on dock legs with the correct Leave/Arrive labels and Prepare texts, Prepare anchor opens Arriving at Destination and Prepare dock opens Returning to Dock (on the admin boat)). All features work. One data-dependent defect is listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: The Pro test boat (test-user-pro/main) has no arrivingDest or returningDock list in its registry (they are not in the list selector either). Tapping 'Prepare to berth' there quietly lands on registry[0] ('Rigging Checks'), because pickList sets an unknown id and `active` falls back. Fix: only dispatch when the list exists, or show a toast or restore the system list. It works on the admin boat, which has the lists.

issues: Editing Leg N's DESTINATION or finish does not flow on to Leg N+1's START or departure, and there is no warning when they no longer match (seen: Leg 2 dest changed to Endeavour Inlet, Leg 3 still starts at Ship Cove). Deleting a middle leg also leaves a gap.
Estimated Finish is 'mandatory' only as a red message; nothing blocks the user without it (fine if that is what was meant).
Sonner toasts at the bottom cover the item rows briefly on mobile (minor).

action_items: TripConfirm/openList: handle a missing arrivingDest/returningDock list (do not fall back to the first list); also check why test-user-pro/main has no Arriving at Destination/Returning to Dock/Leaving Dock lists
Optional: when a leg's destination or finish changes, offer to update the next leg's START and departure
critical_code_review_comments: Boat.weather validator (server.py weather_size) replaces the WHOLE weather dict with {} if it goes over 24000 chars. With legs, advice (up to 6000) and photos now all inside weather, a long plan could quietly wipe the Route Plan. Better to reject with a 413 or trim the oldest legs.

Cupboard photos: uploading then Cancel, or removing a photo in Edit Cupboard, leaves orphan entries in user_boats.area_photos (2 were created and cleaned up during this test). This was already the case before these changes.
TripTiming prop is called finishRequired but is true only for the interim dialog, where the required message is hidden. The inverted name is confusing; rename it to interim.

The interim New departure dialog could not be opened in the UI: the admin boat has no vessel/callsign, and the pro boat has no Arriving list. The code shows NavigatorAsk interim hides ArriveType, PlannedLegs and the finish-required message.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Temporary TEST_Box A/B subs on the pro Fridge were deleted; the extra Fridge photo was removed and the orphan area_photos were pulled by id; the Red lettuce qty and removed flag were restored. Pro boat weather/route_start/route_dest were restored from a backup taken before testing. Admin boat weather/route were reset to the original {} and ''. show_sundowners for the pro user was set back to false.
